name: awesome-online-ide
desc: 🌩️ A list of awesome online development environments

resources.name: StackBlitz
resources.desc: Run JavaScript with starting templates for Angular, React, or Ionic with full intellisense + instant error checking.

resources.name: Nativescript Playground
resources.desc: Run NativeScript with Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Vue.js on your mobile iOS or Android device by scanning a QR code.

resources.name: Glitch
resources.desc: Run full Node.js projects with support for automating hosting, version control, CDN for assets, secure storage of secrets, real-time collaboration, full console access, GitHub import/export, server-side debugger, instant deployments, and more.

resources.name: Browxy
resources.desc: Run Java, C, C++, C#, Python, or PHP with some syntax highlighting, input arguments, and publish to a public URL.

resources.name: JDoodle
resources.desc: Run snippets from over 100 languages including Haskell, Prolog, MySQL, and MongoDB.

resources.name: Judge0
resources.desc: Run snippets from over 40 languages including Erlang, Elixir, OCaml and Octave.

resources.name: Ideone
resources.desc: Run snippets from over 60 languages including AWK, Swift, and SQLite.

resources.name: CPP Shell
resources.desc: Run C++ snippets with input flags for warning level and optimization level.

resources.name: RunKit
resources.desc: Run Node.js snippets + visualizations and share with a public URL.

resources.name: OnlineGDB
resources.desc: Run snippets of C, C++, Java, Python, PHP, HTML with some intellisense code-completion.

resources.name: Go Playground
resources.desc: Run snippets for Go programming language.

resources.name: Rust Playground
resources.desc: Run snippets of Rust programming language.

resources.name: Python Tutor
resources.desc: Run snippets of Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Ruby, C, and C++ code and see detailed step-by-step visualizations of run-time state.

resources.name: Codeboard.io
resources.desc: Run snippets in C, C++, Eiffel, Haskell, Java, Python, and use tests for automatic grading of code written by students.

resources.name: 3v4l PHP Playground
resources.desc: Run PHP snippets on 200+ versions simultaneously with VLD opcodes and performance comparison.

resources.name: myCompiler.io
resources.desc: Run snippets from over 12 languages including C, C++, Java, Python, Ruby, Nodejs and more with auto code-completion, syntax highlighting, collaboration features like forking, commenting and sharing of code snippets.

resources.name: .NET Fiddle
resources.desc: Run C#, F# and VB.net snippets with NuGet Packages.

resources.name: Free Code Compiler
resources.desc: Run snippets from over 19 languages including C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Swift, Lua, and more with syntax highlighting, stdin, and recent snippets.

resources.name: CodePen
resources.desc: Run snippets in HTML/CSS/JS, popular with designers.

resources.name: JSFiddle
resources.desc: Run snippets in HTML/CSS/JS and collaborate in real-time.

resources.name: Plunker
resources.desc: Run snippets in HTML/CSS/JS/TS and collaborate by forking, commenting, and participating in the forums.
